Players Committee card image of [[I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per character, when you deploy Chewie, Lando, Leia, or Luke to a Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. While Han is frozen, Rebels are immune to None Shall Pass. Once per game, may deploy a farm from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/imustbeallowedtospeak_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d8b70bab5e6d97f961c2744b77242248f4d06b96 d8b70ba] (21 January 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
